decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-484ccb5c-7fff-4f4f-1234-0b45ad14a362"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">In the absence of a suitable undertaking to secure that the occupiers of the new residential unit would not be able to apply for on street parking permit, the proposals would have an adverse impact on street parking conditions, highway safety and sustainable modes of transport, contrary to Policies T1 and T4 of the London Plan (2021) and Hackney Local Plan Policies LP43 and LP45.</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-beabec60-7fff-921f-e234-2ee7473b4a12"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed development would result in the provision of substandard and poor form of living conditions for future occupiers due to the failure to adhere to the minimum space standards and does not provide for inclusive access, to the detriment of the long term health and well being of future occupiers of the development, contrary to London Plan (2021) Policy D6, LP2 and LP17 of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-6ea3c3be-7fff-d479-b302-3f0bbabde110"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed development, by reason of lack of provision of affordable housing, would fail to adequately contribute towards the provision of mixed and balanced communities and housing needs in the local area. As such, the development would not be consistent with Policies H4 and H5 of the London Plan (2021), Hackney Local Plan Policies LP12, LP13 and NPPF (2024) paragraph 64 and the Hackney S106 Planning Contributions Supplementary Planning Document (2020).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-a560dd23-7fff-c5ae-66b5-03e0d4bbce00"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed development, by reason of a lack of sufficient energy efficiency measures and/or financial contribution towards carbon offsetting, would fail to achieve the maximum feasible reductions in carbon dioxide emissions, contrary to Hackney Local Plan (LP33) Policy LP55 and London Plan (2021) Policy SI2.</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-687ea808-7fff-ffc7-eb8e-03e30f4f0765"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">By reason of its inappropriate size, scale, and materials, the proposed three-storey residential dwelling would result in an obtrusive and incongruous development that would fail to preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the Stoke Newington Conservation Area. This identified less than substantial harm would not be outweighed by any public benefits. The proposed development would, therefore, conflict with policies D3 (Optimising site layout through the design-led approach), D4 (Delivering good design), and HC1 (Heritage conservation and growth) of the London Plan (2021) and policies LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character) and LP3 (Designated Heritage Assets) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-4c8a5a66-7fff-6668-d1f3-41e8fb9ae15e"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Insufficient marketing evidence has been provided to justify the loss of storage floorspace (Class E/B8 Use). Therefore, the change of use is inconsistent with the requirements of Policy LP35 of the Hackney Local Plan (2020) and policy E2 of the London Plan (2021).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-148799eb-7fff-86b9-4d89-3c73a89e7cdb"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed development, by reason of its size, siting and design would appear unduly overbearing, result in an unacceptable perceived sense of enclosure, and result in undue loss of privacy, detrimental to the residential amenity of neighbouring occupiers, contrary to Policy D4 of the London Plan and Policies LP1 and LP2 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033.</span></span></p>
application_type_full: Full planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Demolition of derelict storage building. Construction of three story three bedroom dwelling house.
